post.summary: Calculate TDS on Non-Salary Payments in Bulk
post.description: Calculate TDS on non-salary payments in bulk under the Income-tax Act, 2025, for dates on or after 1 April 2026. Accepts and returns Sheet JSON workbooks. Each payment is calculated independently using the total of earlier payments you provide.

schema.title: non_salary_payments_workbook
schema.description: Non-salary payments to calculate TDS on under the Income-tax Act, 2025. Each row is one payment to a resident or non-resident payee under section 392(7), 393(1), 393(2) or 393(3), with the amount already paid to that payee earlier in the tax year.

oneOf.description: The payments to calculate TDS on.
One row per payment. The calculator works out each row from that row's values only, so rows don't affect each other.

prefixItems.description:
**payment_id**

Your identifier for the payment, unique within the request. The response returns it in the same row, so you can match each result to its payment.

**payee_type**

The payee's legal status, which the 4th character of its PAN shows. It sets the TDS rate for insurance_commission and for contract work, such as freight_charges and advertisement_fee. It also decides who gets the dividend exemption for individuals (section 393(4), Table: Sl. No. 10(f)) and the e-commerce exemption for individuals and HUFs (section 393(4), Table: Sl. No. 11). interest_from_bank_deposits_for_senior_citizen and investment_income_of_non_resident_indian accept only individual. For a non-resident, company means a foreign company, which takes a higher TDS rate on the section 393(2) entries that use the rates in force.

**residential_status**

resident means the payee is resident in India for the tax year. You report payments to residents in Form 140. For a non_resident payee, the calculator applies the section 393(2) table, which has no thresholds, and you report the payment in Form 144. Sections 392(7) and 393(3) cover every payee, so their natures of payment keep the same section and threshold for a non-resident. A non-resident's TDS rate includes 4% health and education cess. It doesn't include surcharge or a tax treaty (DTAA) rate.

**nature_of_payment**

What the payment is for. Residents and non-residents take different values. The [nature of payment](https://developer.sandbox.co.in/api-reference/tds/annexures/tds_annexures#nature-of-payment) annexure lists the values for each residential_status.

**payment_amount**

The amount credited or paid, in rupees. For payment_for_e-commerce_transactions, send the gross amount of the sale or services, including any amount the buyer paid the participant directly (section 393(1), Table: Sl. No. 8(v), Note 3(b)). For work under section 402(47)(e), send the invoice value without the material that the invoice shows separately. For services, leave out GST that the contract or invoice shows separately (CBDT Circular 23/2017, kept in force by section 536(2)(j)).

**year_to_date_payment_amount**

The total you credited or paid to this payee earlier in the tax year, before this payment, for the natures of payment that share this payment's threshold. Natures of payment that return the same section in the response share a threshold, such as professional_services and consulting_services. Send 0 for the payee's first payment. For equipment_rental_charges and lease_and_rental_payment, send the rent already credited or paid to this payee in the same month. The calculator uses this value only to check the threshold, and never deducts TDS on it. It ignores the value for natures of payment with no threshold, and for winnings, whose threshold applies to each payment.

**credit_or_payment_date_epoch**

The earlier of the date you credited the amount to the payee's account and the date you paid it (section 393(1)(c)). A credit to a suspense account counts as a credit (section 393(11)). For dividend, send the date you pay or distribute the dividend, even if you declared or credited it earlier, because the Act requires TDS before payment or distribution (section 393(1), Table: Sl. No. 7, Note). For winnings, including horse race winnings, and for withdrawal_from_nss_deposit and payment_of_accumulated_balance_of_provident_fund, send the payment date, because the Act requires TDS on these at the time of payment (sections 393(3)(c) and 392(7)). The date must be on or after 1 April 2026. Send it in epoch milliseconds, at 00:00 IST.

**pan_status**

The payee's PAN status on the credit or payment date. operative means the payee gave a valid PAN that is operative. inoperative covers every case where you can't use a PAN for the payee. The PAN is inoperative under section 262(6), or the payee gave no PAN, has only applied for one, or gave an invalid one. An inoperative payment takes the higher TDS rate of section 397(2)(b)(i), and the response sets reason_for_lower_deduction to deduction_of_tax_at_higher_rate_due_to_non_availability_of_pan_u_s_397_2.

data.title: tds_on_non_salary_payments_workbook
data.description: TDS on each non-salary payment in the request: the section, section code, TDS rate, TDS amount and deposit due date, with the reason for any nil or higher TDS.

oneOf.description: The TDS on each payment in the request.
One row per payment in the request, in request order.

prefixItems.description:
**payment_id**

payment_id from the request.

**payee_type**

payee_type from the request.

**residential_status**

residential_status from the request.

**nature_of_payment**

nature_of_payment from the request.

**section**

The section of the Income-tax Act, 2025 that covers this payment, down to the table entry that sets the TDS rate. Payments with the same section share a threshold.

**section_code**

The section code to report the payment under in Form 140 or Form 144, from Annexure 2 of the CBDT file formats.

**payment_amount**

payment_amount from the request.

**year_to_date_payment_amount**

year_to_date_payment_amount from the request.

**credit_or_payment_date_epoch**

credit_or_payment_date_epoch from the request.

**pan_status**

pan_status from the request.

**taxable_amount**

The part of payment_amount that TDS applies to. If payment_amount plus year_to_date_payment_amount crosses the threshold, taxable_amount is all of payment_amount. Otherwise it is 0. For natures of payment with no threshold, it is all of payment_amount. For section code 1031, such as payment_of_certain_sums_for_purchase_of_goods, it is only the part of payment_amount that takes the sum above ₹50,00,000 (section 393(1), Table: Sl. No. 8(ii), Note 1(b)).

**tds_rate**

The TDS rate applied to taxable_amount, in percent. 0 when no TDS applies. For a non-resident payee, the rate includes 4% health and education cess, so a 20% rate becomes 20.8.

**tax_deductible_on_payment**

The TDS to deduct when you credit or pay this payment, and the amount you report for it in Form 140 or Form 144. It is taxable_amount times tds_rate, rounded half up to the nearest paisa. It doesn't include TDS on earlier payments.

**deposit_due_date_epoch**

The date by which you deposit tax_deductible_on_payment with the government, under rule 218(2), in epoch milliseconds. Null when no TDS applies.

**reason_for_lower_deduction**

Why TDS is nil or higher than the section's TDS rate. The values are the reason codes of Forms 140 and 144. Null when the section's TDS rate applies.

is_pan_operative.description: Whether the PAN of the deductee is Operative. Possible Values: true or false
